pool.text: Teresa of Leon married Henry of Burgundy who received the County of Portugal as dowry
Porto hosted the marriage of John I and Philippa cementing the Anglo-Portuguese alliance
Prince Henry the Navigator launched the Conquest of Ceuta from Porto
The Methuen Treaty strengthened commercial and military ties with England
English firms established trading posts and began dominating the port wine trade
The revolt of the drunkards occurred during which company buildings were attacked
Queen Mary I established a drawing class that originated the fine arts school
The Liberal Revolution began advocating a constitutional monarchy and return of the king
Kadoorie Synagogue was inaugurated as one of the largest in Europe
The historic core was named a World Heritage Site by UNESCO
Porto shared the designation European Culture Capital with Rotterdam
The newest bridge Infante Dom Henrique Bridge was finished
The municipality funded a public sculpture to be built in Matosinhos
A new highway the A32 was completed to connect the metropolitan area
A new cruise terminal was opened at the port of Leixões
The state-owned development bank Banco Português de Fomento was established
Porto was named City of the Year by Food and Travel magazine
The city was named World's Leading Seaside Metropolitan Destination at awards
Pedro Duarte took office as the current mayor of Porto
A Bus rapid transit managed by Porto Metro has been operating
